papers.title_en: TRACE: Typed Reference-Aware Conversational Editing for Humanoid Motion Diffusion
papers.authors: Zejian Kang, Yifu Luo, Boyang Shen, Jingxuan Li, Zekai Chen, Zekun Shi, Yongxue Xu, Zhenyu Hou, Bingqian Wu, Shaolei Zhang, Wentao Yang, Xiangru Huang
papers.evidence: 基于扩散生成器的语言条件人形动作生成与编辑
papers.tldr: 语言驱动的类人动作生成难以把模糊指令落实到可修改的具体动作结构。TRACE 以类型化可测运动学量为核心，把生成条件锚定在配对训练动作上，用语言模型预测支撑、根、手部事件并注入扩散生成器；编辑阶段则以类型化请求定义身体-时间范围与相对目标，由参考条件扩散编辑器实现修改，并在采样时投影保护状态坐标。评测显示语义对齐与动作质量优于对比方法，多轮相对编辑更可靠。
papers.abstract_en: Language-conditioned humanoid motion generation enables users to create and refine robot movements through natural language. The central challenge is to connect an underspecified request to concrete motion structure that can subsequently be revised relative to an accepted reference. We present TRACE, a generation and editing framework for the Unitree G1 humanoid robot built around typed, measurable kinematic quantities. Our insight is to ground generation conditions in paired training motions and editing goals in the current motion. A language model learns to predict support, root, and hand events from motion-derived supervision; their time-aligned encodings complement the original text in a diffusion generator. Gravity-referenced states and trajectory--contact objectives improve kinematic consistency. For editing, typed requests define body--time scopes and source-relative goals. A separate reference-conditioned diffusion editor uses these goals and revised events to realize changes, while sampling-time projection preserves protected state coordinates. Quantitative evaluation and human assessment show improved semantic alignment and motion quality over the compared methods. Controlled ablations support the value of motion-grounded conditioning and kinematic consistency, while multi-turn editing evaluations demonstrate more reliable execution of successive relative requests under shared preservation constraints. Together, these results support typed kinematic structure as a common basis for motion generation and reference-aware revision.

papers.title_en: PrT-Flow: Probability-Tractable Flow Matching for Reinforcement Learning
papers.evidence: 可计算概率的流匹配用于生成式动作建模
papers.tldr: 扩散模型与 Flow Matching 能灵活表示机器人多模态动作，但许多强化学习算法仍需计算每个动作的概率密度。PrT-Flow 提出概率可计算的流匹配方法：其 Jacobian-Tractable Transformer 让每步采样可逆，并保留多模态、多步动作生成能力，从而高效求雅可比行列式；Conditional Euler-step Training 则监督单步位移而非瞬时速度。理论上证明该训练与拟合 Flow Matching 的 Euler 求解器更新具有相同极小值。在 Robomimic Lift 上经300轮模仿学习达96%成功率，在 OGBench Cube-Triple 上经60万在线步达96%成功率，并可支持 SAC 式 actor-critic 训练。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models and Flow Matching can represent flexible distributions over robot actions, but many reinforcement learning algorithms also require the probability of each action. We introduce PrT-Flow (Probability-Tractable Flow Matching), which computes probability density while retaining multimodal, multi-step action generation. Its Jacobian-Tractable Transformer (JTT) makes each sampling step invertible and enables efficient computation of its Jacobian determinant. We train these finite steps with Conditional Euler-step Training (CET), which supervises their displacement over one step during sampling rather than their instantaneous velocity. We prove that, under certain assumptions, CET has the same minimizers as fitting the Euler-solver updates of Flow Matching. PrT-Flow achieves 96% success on Robomimic Lift after 300 epochs of imitation learning, matching the diffusion policy reference, and 96% success on OGBench Cube-Triple after 600k online steps. These results demonstrate that invertible networks with tractable probability densities can learn effective robot policies and support SAC-style actor-critic training. Our code is available at https://github.com/Sunlight-zero/PrT-Flow .

papers.title_en: Weighted Adjoint Matching: Finetuning Flow Matching Models with Time-Dependent Control Cost
papers.evidence: 微调预训练的流匹配与扩散模型
papers.tldr: 针对扩散与流匹配模型微调中奖励提升与生成多样性难以兼顾的问题，本文提出加权伴随匹配（Weighted Adjoint Matching）。该方法在伴随匹配的随机最优控制框架上，为二次控制代价引入时间相关权重：生成早期施加强约束以保持粗粒度语义的平衡与多样性，后期放松约束以精修细节提升奖励。理论上证明其等价于在生成路径上施加时变KL正则的奖励最大化。在高斯混合与MNIST实验中，相较伴随匹配取得更优的奖励-模式平衡权衡。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Weighted Adjoint Matching, a method to finetune a pretrained diffusion or flow matching model given a differentiable reward. We derive it from Adjoint Matching, which reformulates finetuning as a stochastic optimal control problem with a quadratic control cost. Building on the observation that these models generate coarse features before fine details, we place a time-dependent weight on the control cost. A high cost early in the generative process preserves balance and diversity in the coarse features, which carry most of the semantics, while a low cost at the end lets the model increase the reward by refining details. We prove that our method is equivalent to maximizing the reward under time-varying Kullback--Leibler regularization on the generative paths. Experiments on Gaussian mixtures and on MNIST show a better tradeoff between reward and mode balance than Adjoint Matching.

papers.title_en: Semantic Latent Alignment for Flow Matching with Invertible Bi-Lipschitz Adapters
papers.authors: Felix Nützel, Mischa Dombrowski, Luca Hagen, Bernhard Kainz
papers.evidence: 面向流匹配生成器的语义潜空间对齐
papers.tldr: 预训练潜空间在压缩、重建与下游生成可学习性间存在权衡，适配新领域往往需昂贵继续训练。本文固定编解码器，仅在其中插入可逆双Lipschitz适配器，先离线对齐语义教师，再冻结用于类条件流匹配。在两项医学影像数据上，该方法提升特征指标、种子稳定性与反事实编辑强度，同时分类性能有竞争力。其贡献在于以受约束的后验潜空间适配，实现参数高效且免调优的生成改进。
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained latent spaces trade compression, reconstruction, and the learnability of the coordinates a downstream generator has to work in, which complicates adapting these spaces to different domains or tasks: continued training is expensive, and without a new alignment objective it often fails to improve downstream generation. We instead leave the encoder and decoder fixed and change only the coordinates between them, using an invertible bi-Lipschitz adapter aligned offline to a semantic teacher and frozen during class-conditional flow matching. Invertibility preserves compatibility with the pretrained autoencoder, while the bi-Lipschitz constraint limits how far alignment can distort its latent geometry. This provides a simple way to improve semantic organization while retaining the compression and reconstruction properties of the original latent space. On two medical imaging datasets, constrained latent adaptation improves feature metrics, seed stability and counterfactual edit strength, while remaining competitive on downstream classification. In contrast, unconstrained adaptation can become highly anisotropic and sensitive despite remaining invertible, highlighting the importance of controlling geometric distortion. Our results suggest that carefully constrained post-hoc adaptation offers a parameter-efficient and tuning-free alternative to jointly modifying the representation during generative training.

papers.authors: Neil De La Fuente, Joan Lafuente, Mukhammadali Sayfiddinov, Felicia Scharitzer, Marc Pollefeys, Ata Celen, Sayan Deb Sarkar, Elisabetta Fedele
papers.evidence: 用于局部可控3D生成的生成流过程
papers.tldr: 现有3D生成缺乏显式局部控制，几何遵循常由全局强度决定，外观也难以局部指定。SpaceFlow提出免训练流程，用几何基元作为部件代理并赋予局部控制级别，在生成流过程中施加空间约束，再对结构分割匹配基元并路由文本/图像线索。区域几何指标显示高控制区保持指定形状、低控制区可合理变化，外观评测取得更优提示忠实度与颜色材质精度。该方法实现了局部可控的3D生成，在几何保真与生成自由间取得有竞争力的平衡。
papers.abstract_en: Current 3D generation methods lack explicit local control: geometric adherence is often defined by a global control strength, and appearance cannot be specified locally. We present SpaceFlow, a training-free pipeline for locally controllable 3D generation from text descriptions and a collection of geometric primitives. Each primitive serves as a proxy for an object part and is assigned a local control level, enabling users to specify whether regions should strictly follow the input shape or allow generative completion. During structure generation, we enforce these spatial constraints within the generative flow process. For appearance synthesis, the generated structure is segmented and matched to the primitives. Each generated part is conditioned only on its assigned text or image cue, thereby limiting cross-part leakage. Regional geometry metrics demonstrate that SpaceFlow preserves the specified geometry in high-control regions and enables plausible shape variation in low-control areas. A user study further indicates that the resulting balance between geometric fidelity and generative freedom remains competitive in overall quality. When evaluating appearance on fixed geometry, text-conditioned routing achieves state-of-the-art prompt faithfulness and color/material accuracy. Qualitative results additionally show localized routing of image cues. The project page is available at SpaceFlow3D.github.io.

papers.title_en: Reinforcement Learning via Fixed-point Flow Matching
papers.authors: Denis Blessing, Onur Celik, Gerhard Neumann
papers.evidence: 定点流匹配用于策略生成
papers.tldr: 最大熵与行为约束强化学习中，最优策略常为复杂多峰的 Boltzmann 分布，采样困难。传统 flow matching 能表达此类分布，但在线 RL 缺少训练数据。本文提出固定点流匹配 FFM：无需数据，将 actor 更新化为固定点迭代，并以 critic 的动作梯度作为流匹配回归目标。实验显示，FFM 能在离线到在线中有效微调预训练流策略，也能在在线 RL 中从零高效训练。该工作为无数据学习 expressive 流策略提供了新途径。
papers.abstract_en: In maximum entropy and behavior-constrained reinforcement learning (RL), the optimal policy is given by a Boltzmann distribution. Generating samples from this distribution can be challenging, as it is often complex and multimodal. While flow policies trained with flow matching provide a powerful framework for representing such distributions, they traditionally rely on access to training data, which is generally unavailable in online RL. To address this limitation, we propose fixed-point flow matching (FFM), a data-free procedure for training and fine-tuning flow policies in RL. FFM leverages the target flow identity to formulate the actor update as a fixed-point iteration, utilizing a flow-matching-style regression objective where the critic's action gradients serve as regression targets. We show that the optimal policy is a fixed point of this iteration. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that FFM effectively fine-tunes pretrained flow policies in the offline-to-online setting and enables efficient and accurate training of flow policies from scratch in online RL. These results establish fixed-point flow matching as a principled approach for learning expressive flow-based policies without requiring training data.

papers.title_en: Akule: Fast and Scalable Multi-Robot Motion Planning via Sparse Interaction Diffusion
papers.authors: Manav Vora, Gokul Puthumanaillam, Aditya Penumarti, Jane Shin, Melkior Ornik
papers.evidence: 扩散模型用于轨迹运动规划
papers.tldr: 多机器人运动规划中扩散先验表达强，但大规模联合去噪计算昂贵。Akule 用稀疏交互扩散，在冻结单机器人先验上加入成对修正、上下文选择与组合模块，只计算关键交互并合成协调更新。联合轨迹再交搜索规划器验证修复。基准中取得竞争成功率、最高25倍加速，并支持256机器人。该方法将交互选择与组合学习化，为大规模多机器人扩散规划提供可扩展方案。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models provide expressive trajectory priors for multi-robot motion planning (MRMP), but scaling them to large teams requires coordinating individual motions without expensive joint computation. We introduce Akule, a sparse interaction diffusion framework that augments a frozen single-robot prior with three learned modules: a reusable pairwise correction model $R_φ$, a contextual selector $U_ψ$ that determines which corrections to evaluate, and a composer $G_ω$ that combines their effects through context-dependent signed weights. This decomposition separates which interactions merit computation from how their effects should be combined into coordinated denoising updates. We train $R_φ$ using matched pairwise trajectory optimizations, then learn $G_ω$ and $U_ψ$ from physically optimized joint trajectories without requiring a prescribed ground-truth interaction graph. The resulting joint proposals are passed to a downstream search-based planner for validation and repair. Across diverse MRMP benchmarks, Akule achieves competitive planning success, complete-planner speedups of up to $25\times$, zero-shot population transfer, and successful planning with up to $256$ robots. Ablations further demonstrate that learned selection and composition reduce pre-repair conflicts and downstream repair effort relative to heuristic selection and uniform summation.

papers.title_en: Controllable Diverse Sampling through Pullback Directions
papers.authors: Sylvain Dehayem Kenfouo, Aaron Zweig, Mingxuan Zhang, Elham Azizi
papers.evidence: 条件扩散模型的多样化采样
papers.tldr: 条件扩散模型虽能生成贴合提示的高质量图像，但不同随机种子下结果仍高度相似，限制创意探索。现有方法或需额外优化与采样开销，或强扰动导致失真与对齐下降。本文提出免训练方法，利用条件嵌入空间到图像空间的映射所诱导的局部拉回几何，识别输出最敏感方向，并沿这些方向引导不同采样轨迹。在 MS-COCO 与 BrushNet 上，该方法提升了文本条件生成和修复的多样性，同时保持条件一致性。
papers.abstract_en: Conditional diffusion models can generate high-quality images that align closely with a given prompt. However, samples generated from different random seeds may remain visually similar, limiting creative exploration. Existing approaches can increase variation, but often require additional optimization or sampling overhead, while stronger perturbations may introduce distortions that degrade image quality or prompt alignment. We propose a training-free method that leverages the local pullback geometry induced by the mapping from the conditioning-embedding space to the image space to identify directions of maximal output sensitivity. By steering different sampling trajectories along these directions, we encourage distinct generations while maintaining consistency with the conditioning signal. Experiments on MS-COCO and BrushNet show the efficacy of the method in improving diversity on prompt-conditioned image generation and inpainting.

papers.title_en: $Δ$ Flow Matching for Robot Foundation Models
papers.authors: Kuangji Zuo, Tuo An, Xinying Guo, Gen Li, Mengfei Zhao, Jiaqi Bai, Bofan Lyu, Zhuoyuan Yu, Jinghan Yang, Jiayi Li, Jindou Jia, Jianfei Yang
papers.evidence: 流匹配生成范式用于机器人动作生成
papers.tldr: 机器人基础模型的流匹配生成通常从固定高斯先验出发，忽略历史与未来的时序连续性，导致训练昂贵、采样需多步迭代。Δ-flow 改用近期历史加轻度噪声构造源分布，使其更接近目标，只需求解小残差 Δ，实现高效训练与单步推理。在 LIBERO 上 ImageWAM 单轮即达 90% 成功率，Fast-WAM 两轮达 95%，单步推理提速最高 4.45×，动作 jerk 降低 4.5×，并在 LIBERO-Plus 取得 SOTA 泛化。该工作表明历史源可免重训迁移到预训练策略，简单有效提升效率与泛化。
papers.abstract_en: Flow matching is a common generative recipe for robot foundation models. Vision-language-action models (VLAs) generate action chunks, while world-action models (WAMs) additionally generate future visual states. Both start generation from a fixed Gaussian prior, despite temporal continuity between past and future states and actions. This requires costly training and iterative sampling, especially for WAMs with an additional visual branch. We introduce $Δ$-flow, which constructs the source from recent history with mild noise rather than from a fixed Gaussian prior. This moves the source closer to the target, reducing transport to a small residual $Δ$ that can be learned efficiently and enables single-step inference. We integrate $Δ$-flow into the VLA policy $π_{0.5}$ and the WAM policies ImageWAM and Fast-WAM. On LIBERO, ImageWAM reaches 90% success in one epoch rather than six, and Fast-WAM reaches 95% in two epochs rather than eight. With LoRA fine-tuning, $π_{0.5}$ exceeds its baseline's five-epoch performance after one epoch. Single-step inference gives $1.54\times$, $2.49\times$, and $4.45\times$ speedups on $π_{0.5}$, ImageWAM, and Fast-WAM, respectively. It preserves action smoothness, achieving a $4.5\times$ reduction in action jerk compared with one-step Gaussian sampling. $Δ$-flow reaches state-of-the-art generalization performance on LIBERO-Plus. Action-history sources can be applied to pretrained WAM policies without retraining. Replacing the Gaussian action source at inference largely preserves task success with a single sampling step and can slightly improve it. We further study how action representation and visual information in action learning affect history-to-future prediction in $Δ$-flow. These results show that $Δ$-flow is simple yet effective, improving the efficiency and generalization of robot foundation models.

papers.title_en: A Survey of Flow Matching in Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Nabuat Zaman Nahim, Fairoz Nower Khan, Peizhong Ju
papers.tldr: 流匹配（FM）正成为强化学习（RL）中高效生成式建模框架，但相关研究分散于离线连续控制、在线微调与基础模型对齐，缺乏统一梳理。本文系统综述流匹配强化学习，沿“建模目标分布”与“RL信号融合机制”两轴构建分类体系，涵盖动作策略、价值评论家、转移动态，以及能量加权回归、流策略梯度、GRPO等。文章还比较高斯与扩散基线，讨论离散/非欧动作空间等前沿，并给出开放问题。该综述为下一代生成式RL与对齐提供路线图。
papers.abstract_en: Flow Matching (FM) has recently emerged as a principled and efficient generative modeling framework for reinforcement learning (RL), enabling expressive, multimodal policy parameterizations via deterministic probability transport. Compared to diffusion-based policies that rely on stochastic denoising chains, FM uses sampling based on ordinary differential equations (ODEs), with learned velocity fields, which can substantially reduce inference latency and simplify the incorporation of RL objectives. As research in flow-based RL rapidly accelerates across offline continuous control, online fine-tuning, and foundation model alignment, the literature has become highly fragmented. In this survey, we provide a comprehensive taxonomy of flow-matching approaches in reinforcement learning. We organize the literature along two axes: the target distribution being modeled (e.g., action policies, value critics, transition dynamics) and the mechanism of RL signal integration (e.g., energy-weighted regression, flow-based policy gradients, and group relative policy optimization). Furthermore, we survey emerging frontiers such as discrete and non-Euclidean action spaces, provide a systematic comparative analysis against Gaussian and diffusion baselines, and outline critical open problems. Ultimately, this survey serves as a foundational roadmap for the next generation of generative reinforcement learning and alignment.

papers.title_en: JtT: Rethinking Point Trajectory Diffusion for Diverse and Rigid Motion from an Image
papers.authors: Gabrijel Boduljak, Yushi Lan, Christian Rupprecht, Andrea Vedaldi
papers.evidence: 用扩散Transformer生成多样刚体运动轨迹
papers.tldr: 从单张图像预测刚体运动需生成多样且物理合理的未来轨迹，但现有轨迹生成器在简单合成场景也会失败。JtT 采用扩散 Transformer，直接在坐标空间解码任意稠密查询点，无需轨迹 VAE 或固定网格。研究发现，只有扩散逐帧速度并配合合适时间步调度才能捕捉刚性，同时在查询点加入全分辨率 RGB 可解决边界失败。该模型仅约 50M 参数，在更严格的评估协议下同时提升分布与刚性指标。
papers.abstract_en: We study forecasting rigid-body motion from a single image: generating diverse and physically plausible future trajectories for arbitrary points in a scene, without building rigidity into the architecture or relying on geometric inputs such as depth. Like video generators, recent trajectory generators fail at this task, even in simple synthetic Kubric scenes, despite scaling up model size and training on real data.   We show how to solve this with the right architecture and parameterization. Our model, JtT, is a simple diffusion transformer that operates directly in coordinate space and decodes arbitrary and dense query patterns, without the trajectory VAEs or fixed grids assumed in prior work. Through a systematic study of the design space of point trajectory diffusion, we find that diffusing per-frame velocities is the only parameterization that captures rigidity, that it must be paired with the right timestep schedule, and that adding full-resolution RGB at the query points resolves the boundary failures of prior methods.   However, evaluating such 2D models rigorously is itself non-trivial. To our knowledge, we are the first to observe that physical plausibility and diversity do not improve together during training: larger models, as used in prior work, memorize the single ground-truth future per training image, becoming more rigid while covering fewer possible futures.   Yet prior work has paid little attention to this, so we show how model rankings depend on model size, metric, and stopping time, and adopt a stricter, checkpoint-averaged evaluation protocol. Under this protocol, JtT improves over prior methods on both distributional and rigidity metrics and approaches ground-truth rigidity, with only about 50M parameters.

papers.title_en: PixelMoE: Scaling Pixel-Space Diffusion with LLM-Style Mixture-of-Experts
papers.authors: Ruixiao Dong, Jianmin Bao, Bozhi Luan, Zijie Meng, Xin Tao, Pengfei Wan, Kun Gai, Li Li, Houqiang Li
papers.evidence: 像素空间扩散生成框架
papers.tldr: 像素空间扩散可直接建模原图而无需 tokenizer，但此前扩展多采用稠密策略，导致模型容量与激活计算强耦合。PixelMoE 将标准 LLM 式 MoE 迁移到像素扩散，并用 Token-Choice 路由、细粒度专家、共享专家与偏置负载均衡实现稀疏扩展。它还提出像素空间分层流匹配，沿去噪轨迹改变空间分辨率，从全局结构形成过渡到细粒度细节精修。在相近激活参数量下，PixelMoE 各规模均优于稠密基线；ImageNet-1K 上 256×256 FID 1.47、512×512 FID 1.53，且无需表示对齐或感知损失。
papers.abstract_en: Pixel-space diffusion models provide an appealing alternative to latent-space diffusion models by directly modeling raw images without relying on a learned tokenizer. However, scaling pixel-space models has predominantly followed dense strategies, tightly coupling model capacity with active computation. In this work, we show that standard LLM-style Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures can be effectively transferred to pixel-space diffusion. Building on this finding, we introduce PixelMoE, a pixel-space generative framework that sparsely scales model capacity with standard LLM-style MoE, without diffusion-specific routing mechanisms or auxiliary routing objectives. Specifically, PixelMoE combines standard Token-Choice (TC) routing with fine-grained routed experts for input-adaptive sparse computation, a shared expert for capturing common representations, and a bias-based load-balancing strategy. To complement sparse capacity scaling, PixelMoE further introduces Pixel-Space Hierarchical Flow Matching, which varies spatial resolution along the denoising trajectory from global structure formation to fine-grained detail refinement. At comparable active parameter counts, PixelMoE consistently outperforms its dense counterparts across model scales, demonstrating effective sparse capacity scaling in pixel space. On class-conditional ImageNet-1K, PixelMoE achieves FID scores of 1.47 at 256x256 and 1.53 at 512x512 without representation alignment or perceptual losses, comparing favorably with leading pixel-space and latent-space generative models. Code and models will be released soon.
